boards.name: Build · Data, science and persistence
boards.jsx:
(
INTERNAL BUILD CONTRACT · SECTOR INTELLIGENCE v1.1
Build · Data, science and persistence
Extend the active v1.0 implementation with Prophet v5.1. Keep original owners, evidence and live writers.
Source: https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/blob/0ccc0fbe31e9a08eab999ce514e9b9d8f8be9788/research/sector_completion_20261021/PROPHET_V51_INTEGRATION_AMENDMENT_2026-11-09.md
A · Capture once. Keep the full population.
USER JOB
Move from a market or sector decision into every eligible member and the right Prophet Setup.
OWNER / SOURCE
Existing Macro generation and membership owners → Prophet immutable read bundle; Terminal lane 3 presents it.
INPUTS / IDENTITY
Native group, issuer and listing IDs; exact bridge version; source + knowledge clocks; basis, rights, full counts and captured refs.
CALCULATION / CLAIM
20 completed sessions is this fixture's window. Native 21/63 stays distinct. Membership, research coverage and access are separate.
INTERACTION
Search before paging. Select with checkbox; Open Setup is a different action. Preserve filters, comparison and return context.
STATES
52 covered + 5 uncovered + 3 unresolved = 60 illustrative members. Missing/denied/stale/zero are distinct; never guess an identity.
PROOF
One captured context for all panels; complete pages and group joins; later publication cannot change the in-flight decision.
CUSTODY
Extend lane 1's bounded authenticated reader, 4 MiB ceiling and finite JSON. Keep its HOLD and shared lane 3 file ownership.
B · Independent peers. Original company evidence.
USER JOB
Find sector support, then test what the company adds and what could weaken the case.
OWNER / SOURCE
Sector membership/aggregation owns peers. Existing issuer evidence and Research owners supply original observations.
INPUTS / IDENTITY
All listings/aliases of the same issuer; frozen start weights; original filings, measures, reporting periods and availability times.
CALCULATION / CLAIM
Show full group for description; exclude the entire issuer for confirmation. Reveal removed weight, residual coverage and concentration.
INTERACTION
Inspect excluded listings and shared sources. Open exact company evidence, then return to the selected member and source version.
STATES
60 eligible = 40 reported + 20 unreported; 40 = 32 comparable + 8 noncomparable; 32 = 19 improved + 9 weakened + 4 unchanged.
PROOF
Perturb excluded issuer inputs while benchmark, membership and other inputs stay frozen. Peer-only context must be unchanged.
CUSTODY
No Prophet winners, rankings or confidence become upstream facts. Dedupe source roots; do not claim statistical independence from that alone.
C · Separate history from qualified forecasts.
USER JOB
Understand observed participation and cycles, then see only predictions supported by the relevant current evidence.
OWNER / SOURCE
Existing Sector Cycles/hazard/science lane 8; Prophet consumes qualified context. No second forecast engine.
INPUTS / IDENTITY
Event time, confirmation/first-known time, feature cutoff, retained vintages, membership history, model and calibration versions.
CALCULATION / CLAIM
Four separate heads: remaining-return distribution, adverse tail, target-before-invalidation and transition timing.
INTERACTION
Unavailable forecasts retain useful observed cycles and explanation. Exact values and calendar/session definitions stay inspectable.
STATES
Current #10924 withholds hazard and the malformed prior. No age-based upside gauge or historical 4/6 pass promoted to current output.
PROOF
No future disclosure leakage. Confirmed pivots use first-known time. Historical windows stay anchored as the observation date advances.
CUSTODY
Owner-only qualification/retraction. No model number from an unavailable head; stale probabilities cannot survive a source correction.
D · Compose retained records through lane 6.
USER JOB
Save the exact reasoning context, reopen it later, and compare it with a separately labelled current view.
OWNER / SOURCE
Existing Investigation/Thesis/admission owner. Terminal #1410 owns the reserved 0049 sequence and actor journal.
INPUTS / IDENTITY
Original source refs + retained bytes/rights; original account; revision and operation receipt; exact Thesis version for Prophet.
CALCULATION / CLAIM
0049 is structural v2 admission, not source retention. Prophet adds compatible v3 decisions/milestones and closed research evidence.
INTERACTION
Install readers before new writes. Check save status after uncertain effects; never replay through a different account.
STATES
Original unavailable; access withdrawn; changed account; in-flight save unknown. Keep user notes and separate current-view action.
PROOF
Read installed validator body first; compose one migration path; test old Options/scenario/review, v1/v2 readers and new v3 parity.
CUSTODY
Never create another 0049 or independent v3 migration against old 0047. Rollback disables new writes while preserving created-record readers.
)

boards.name: Build · Journey, markets and delivery
boards.jsx:
(
INTERNAL BUILD CONTRACT · SECTOR INTELLIGENCE v1.1
Build · Journey, markets and delivery
Extend the active v1.0 implementation with Prophet v5.1. Keep original owners, evidence and live writers.
Source: https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/blob/0ccc0fbe31e9a08eab999ce514e9b9d8f8be9788/research/sector_completion_20261021/PROPHET_V51_INTEGRATION_AMENDMENT_2026-11-09.md
E · One journey, with exact return.
USER JOB
Brief → full members → Prophet Setup → source evidence → return without losing the investigation.
OWNER / SOURCE
Shared shell, existing URL codec and return-context owner; lane 3 integrates shared files once.
INPUTS / IDENTITY
Market, group/listing, filters, sort, selection, page/cursor, active view, captured version and original source refs.
CALCULATION / CLAIM
Raw return differences are percentage points. They do not establish beta-adjusted alpha, selection skill or a trade instruction.
INTERACTION
0/1/2 selection states, separate row actions, named help destinations, focus return, Escape/Back and 44px touch targets.
STATES
Source refusal, coverage gaps, unavailable Setup, old original context, stale request completion and actor changes are explicit.
PROOF
Actual browser journey with coherent source, keyboard/touch, EN/ZH, themes and 320–1440 widths; Paper is design evidence only.
CUSTODY
Preserve all R4 and R5 designs, native Cycles, Calls, Bottoming Watch, flows and four universes. R6 is additive integration depth.
F · Native markets and information clocks.
USER JOB
Read US, Hong Kong or mainland China leadership on the market's own basis and know what was available then.
OWNER / SOURCE
Existing native region, exchange-session, benchmark, listing and corporate-action owners.
INPUTS / IDENTITY
Local currency, exchange calendar, sessions, benchmark and total/price return basis; announcement and first-available times.
CALCULATION / CLAIM
HK fixture: market −4%, group −2%, relative +2 pp. Less negative is still falling. Do not substitute a US close.
INTERACTION
Sources & comparison basis opens endpoints, cutoff, excluded later information and currency treatment. A/H listings remain distinct.
STATES
Local holiday, suspension, unreleased report, later US close, revision and incomplete membership do not become zero or current data.
PROOF
02:30Z cutoff includes 02:29 available evidence; excludes 02:31 and 21:00 even when their event dates are earlier.
CUSTODY
Chinese directional colors follow the shared locale rule. Published/available/ingested/event times retain their distinct meanings.
G · Evaluate participation and keep action owners.
USER JOB
See whether the strategy participated, what cash and allocation cost, and what selection actually contributed.
OWNER / SOURCE
Existing Prophet Strategy Evaluation and authorized Portfolio; current Record types remain unchanged.
INPUTS / IDENTITY
Protocol, period, benchmark, currency, weights, actual/simulated capital, complete eligible decisions, cash, costs and FX.
CALCULATION / CLAIM
Fixture: benchmark 8.0 → strategy net 6.1; gap −1.9 pp. +0.5 pp selection does not erase the total gap.
INTERACTION
Open Evaluation details, attribution method, Coverage and authorized Portfolio. Follow sector, price alert and note have separate capabilities.
STATES
Missing weights prevent reconciliation; near-zero benchmark prevents capture ratio. Material Follow remains unavailable without a real watcher.
PROOF
Common signed attribution scale; cash/cost counted once; decision-time cash reasons; seven comparators and full no-entry/no-fill cohort.
CUSTODY
Do not touch Prophet's unresolved SX05 attribution or older mobile Plans operation. R6 exposes an entry, not a replacement evaluation board.
H · Amend the existing Fable build.
USER JOB
Deliver a useful integrated consumer, then preserve depth through production and operational proof.
OWNER / SOURCE
Existing Fable 5.2 T3 thread 2f136a11-91f9-4bca-bf10-8a1d8b7f4e5d and its nine lanes. No new team or control plane.
INPUTS / IDENTITY
v1.0 B/P/J, 134 stable capabilities, 24 anchors; Prophet v5.1 SI01–SI20 / SP01–SP24; current exact carrier heads.
CALCULATION / CLAIM
Design/fixture/source/served/scientific/operational acceptance are different. Current numerical designs are illustrative.
INTERACTION
First real path: Sector → population → Setup → evidence → exact return. Next: retained save/reopen, upstream economics, qualified evaluation.
STATES
Keep live writers, release holds, denied/unknown effects and unresolved sources. Block the affected capability, continue independent work.
PROOF
Real authorized source, ordinary scheduled update or qualified no-change, correction/withdrawal, compatible rollback and exact original reopen.
CUSTODY
Full brief belongs in GitHub; transport is recipient/action/link/return. Delivery is not Fable adoption or a new START receipt.
)
